item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct 2024 evidence of Tinubu explicitly affirming that opposition could win free and fair elections and peacefully replace him. I also did not find a 2024 reform package focused on election integrity, opposition rights, or election administration that would strongly support this lens. Most available evidence is indirect, coming from how the government treated protests, journalists, and dissent rather than from election-specific conduct.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu receives U.S. ambassador, underscores importance of sustaining democracy, its norms and institutions","publisher":"State House","date":"July 25, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-receives-u-s-ambassador-underscores-importance-of-sustaining-democracy-its-norms-and-institutions/","summary":"Tinubu said protests are part of democracy, but the government would not condone demonstrations that destroy lives and property. This is only indirect evidence for contestable power, but it is one of the clearer pro-democracy statements in the 2024 record.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged that many protesters had legitimate hopes for a better country and asked them to suspend demonstrations to create room for dialogue. This shows some tolerance for public contestation, though it is about protest rather than electoral transfer of power.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","3B.6"]},{"title":"President Tinubu calls for suspension of sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House","date":"February 24, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu urged ECOWAS to choose “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance instead of treating the bloc or junta-led states as enemies. This is positive for acceptance of contestability only by analogy, because it privileges negotiated political outcomes over force.","question_ids":["4B.1","2B.10"]},{"title":"Regional bodies integration key to deepening democracy in Africa, President Tinubu","publisher":"State House","date":"May 22, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/regional-bodies-integration-key-to-deepening-democracy-in-africa-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu called for stronger democratic regional institutions like ECOWAS, EAC, and SADC, arguing that more democracy and more integration were the route to stability. This supports a generic pro-democracy posture, but it does not directly show acceptance of losing power in elections.","question_ids":["4B.1","2B.10"]},{"title":"Tinubu asks protesters to suspend demonstrations, seeks dialogue","publisher":"TheCable","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-tinubu-asks-protesters-to-suspend-demonstrations-seeks-dialogue/","summary":"Tinubu explicitly asked for dialogue rather than immediate force. This is a modest pro-contestation signal, but it is still indirect and reactive.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigerian police teargas protesters, arrest dozens","publisher":"Reuters via VOA","date":"August 3, 2024","url":"https://www.voanews.com/amp/nigerian-police-teargas-protesters-arrest-dozens/7728731.html","summary":"Police used tear gas and arrests to disperse protesters trying to march on government offices. This is negative evidence for tolerance of contestation because it shows coercive suppression of public dissent.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","3B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"September 2, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Prosecutors alleged protesters intended to destabilize the country and incite mutiny. This is strong negative evidence because it reframed dissent as a security threat rather than a normal democratic challenge.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","3B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges 76, including minors, with treason after August protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"November 1, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nigeria-charges-76-including-minors-with-treason-after-august-protests-3698000","summary":"The case expanded to 76 defendants, including minors, after the protests. That looks like punitive escalation and selective punishment, not acceptance of meaningful contestation.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","3B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria considers tough penalties for subversive acts under proposed law","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"August 14, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/nigeria-considers-tough-penalties-for-subversive-acts-under-proposed-law-3571782","summary":"Reuters reported a proposed Counter Subversion Bill that critics said was aimed at cracking down on dissent after the protests. The proposal itself is negative evidence, even though it was later withdrawn.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","3B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Protesters charged with treason","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason","summary":"HRW said protesters, including children, were held for long periods with due-process concerns. This is negative evidence that the administration responded to dissent with repression rather than contestability.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9","3B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House said the Cybercrimes Act’s cyberstalking provision had been used against journalists and activists. That is negative evidence of a chilled public sphere, which weakens any claim of genuine contestability.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.5","3B.3"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"Committee to Protect Journalists","date":"October 3, 2024","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/","summary":"CPJ reported that four journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act despite the February reform. This supports the negative side because it shows continued legal pressure on critical speech.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.5","3B.3"]}]}
